claim_scores.rationale: Shows `dspy.GEPA(...)` raising `TypeError` at construction for a two-arg metric and asserts the error mentions the five-argument requirement.
Defines `bad_metric(gold, pred)` and calls `dspy.GEPA(metric=bad_metric, ...)` inside a `try`/`except TypeError` repro.
Defines `good_metric(gold, pred, trace=None, pred_name=None, pred_trace=None)` and successfully constructs `dspy.GEPA` with it.
Provides `reflection_lm=DummyLM(...)` and exactly one budget control, `max_metric_calls=1`, in both constructor calls.
Directly checks `'five arguments'` in the rejection text and asserts `optimizer.metric_fn is good_metric`.
